newsitem.title: UK: DBS Management to list on FTSE next week.
newsitem.headline: DBS Management to list on FTSE next week.

text.p: Business support services group DBS Management plc applied on Tuesday for official listing on the London Stock Exchange.
In a statement, DBS Management said its dealings are expected to commence on the official list on March 24.
The company's share are joining the "support services" sector of the main market by way of an introduction sponsored by NatWest Markets.
Its shares have been listed on the AIM since July 1995 where it had a market capitalisation of 66.7 million stg at the close of trading on Monday.
